name: Hidden Villa Farms Field Trip
description: PARENTS: A second permission slip went home this week in the white envelope from Hidden Villa Farms! This permission slip is also necessary for your child to be able to participate on the trip! Please make sure to return that to me by next Monday! It allows the kids to be able to interact with the animals and taste some of the edible plants they grow on the farm!

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Please make sure to bring 1 for all 22 friends in our class and to leave "To" section of the card blank for easier pass out! Our bags were unexpectedly on the smaller side this year, so please keep goodies and prizes small this year! Wear PJs to school!

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos this week!! Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair.

name: PTA Budget Meeting
description: Join us for our PTA Budget Meeting on March 30th at 7:00 PM. We encourage everyone to attend and be part of the conversation as we plan for the year ahead.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Deadline
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order: 4/20 — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.

name: Volunteer: PTA Executive Board 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! If you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. Our board positions include: President, Executive VP, VP Enrichment, VP Events and Recognition, VP Fundraising, VP Communications, Secretary, Treasurer, Financial Reviewer, Parliamentarian.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding! Volunteers must be registered with the district and approved by Los Alamitos.
